input: de donde fue el Cine González, 2 cuadras al lago, ½ cuadra arriba
note: A complete, deliverable Managua address in the ordinary Nicaraguan register, and a KNOWN-UNPARSEABLE class today. It has three parts and the union can express one of them. (1) The anchor: 'de donde fue el Cine González' — 'from where the Cine González USED TO BE', a landmark reference in the past tense, pointing at a building that no longer stands. (2) A vector: '2 cuadras al lago' — two blocks toward Lake Xolotlán, which in Managua means north. (3) A second vector: '½ cuadra arriba' — half a block 'up', which means east, because arriba/abajo track the sun rather than terrain. There is no anchor tag, no bearing tag, no distance tag, and no way to mark that the components COMPOSE into an offset from the anchor rather than describing the destination. Only the anchor's proper name is asserted. NO COORDINATE: the described point is roughly two blocks north and half a block east of the cinema, which is NOT the cinema's pin (see ni-ws-antiguo-cine-gonzalez-pluscode), and deriving it would be fabrication. status = known_fail is the accurate label, not a placeholder — this case exists to measure the gap honestly, not to be fixed by tagging.
